title: Popup boxes — what goes in a box, the line under titles, explainer labels

steps.path: Any small popup that does one thing (Rename session, Pick a handle, Create a page)
steps.headline: In a popup that does one thing, should its fields sit in a box, and where do its buttons go?
steps.notice: Whichever you pick becomes the rule for every one-job popup — about 30 of the app's 60 popups. Popups with several labelled sections (Settings, Session details) keep their boxes either way.
steps.risk: Same words, fields and buttons in all three; only the box and the buttons' place change.

variants.label: No box
variants.summary: Fields sit straight on the popup, buttons under them. Fewest layers; the popup itself is the box.

variants.label: Box, buttons outside
variants.summary: Fields in a box, the popup's buttons under the box. What the last round built for Rename and Pick a handle.
variants.risk: A box inside a popup with nothing else in it — what you called arbitrary.

variants.label: Box, buttons inside
variants.summary: Everything, buttons included, in one box. What the last round built for Create a page.
variants.risk: Same extra layer, and the buttons read as belonging to the box rather than the popup.

steps.path: Create a page; a Page's connections (7 popups have this line today)
steps.headline: Should popups have a small grey line under their title?
steps.notice: Seven popups use it today: Create/Edit a page, a Page's connections, Status bar widgets, Specialists, Model settings, Versions and What the assistant was given.

variants.label: Keep the line
variants.summary: Today: a one-line explanation under the title.

variants.label: Remove it
variants.risk: The explanation is gone. For Connections, nobody is told where saved keys live.

variants.label: Move into the popup
variants.summary: Title only; the line moves down into the popup, beside what it explains (top of the form, or under the list).

steps.path: Settings → Appearance → (i), Backup & sync → What is this?
steps.headline: On an (i) page with labelled boxes, should the first box get a label too?
steps.notice: One shared piece draws every (i) page, so this changes all six (Appearance, Backup & sync, Remote access, Context, Permissions, Specialists).

variants.label: Today: no label
variants.summary: The opening summary box has no label; every box after it does.

variants.label: Labelled "Overview"
variants.summary: Every box has a label, the first one "Overview". Tell me in Other if you want different wording.
